reason: This is the only offered combination, and it connects the absorbed nutrients to circulation.

effect: The gut and lung routes now join the same circulation, with nutrients in plasma and oxygen carried by hemoglobin. The chapter is complete.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the two supply routes come together, though the result leaves their delivery to individual cells implicit.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the absorbing lining was most worthwhile: the result showed sugars crossing the gut wall and made absorption distinct from digestion.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the meal into the tract felt like routine setup, with only one available combination and little to decide.

surprise.text: The final picture clarified that absorbed nutrients travel in plasma while oxygen rides on hemoglobin inside red cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although each combination was the only offered gameplay choice, so I was mostly following a prescribed sequence.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the supply network supports working cells, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
